contract.interface:
For a fixed universal Turing machine U, the source proposes a fixed finite canonical phase space, homogeneous quartic K with computable coefficients, homogeneous quadratic observable O and effective exact initial encoding w->z_w. For every rational 0<eta<1, an effectively chosen rational epsilon>0 yields H_eta(z)=||z||^2/2+epsilon K(z)/(1+||z||^2)^2 with global Hessian bounds (1-eta)I <= Hess H <= (1+eta)I. The flow is complete and radius-conserving. All encoded inputs have common radius 1<R^2<2 and common energy R^2/2. Along them O lies in [0,1] and tends to the halting bit: nonhalting inputs always have O<=64/1025<1/8; halting inputs eventually have O>=3/4. This is a complete source-reported constructive proof candidate relative to one published simulator theorem, not independently established correctness or originality.

Mechanism: a polynomial field satisfying x dot Y(x)=0 globally is written Y=A(x)x with polynomial skew A from homogeneous derivatives. The unsymmetrized feature map Psi=(1,x,...,x^tensor L), N=sum_{j=0}^L n^j, gives an exact quadratic skew system Q(v)=B(v)v with fixed anchor. K(q,p)=p dot F(q)-q dot F(p), F(v)=v_0 Q(v), is quartic, Poisson-commutes exactly with the isotropic oscillator, and carries F on p=0. The bounded rational radial factor gives ||Hess[K/(1+r^2)^2]||<=72C for coefficient absolute-sum bound C. The exact trajectory is (v(lambda t) cos t,-v(lambda t) sin t), lambda=epsilon/(1+R^2)^2. Quadratic anchor decoders q_0q_i+p_0p_i recover features without an averaging remainder. The embedded object is a circle extension; the original dynamics are an exact observable factor, not an embedding without the extra phase.

The undecidability corollary imports CMP21 Theorem 3.1 (crediting GCB08), constructs coordinatewise circle compactifications with positive time changes, a fixed-gap halting pulse and a bounded polynomial latch/logistic bit which always tends to zero or one. No infinite computation is collapsed into finite time. After another bounded time change and normalization the tangent polynomial system fits the lift. The input-to-limit map and long-time average are noncomputable even though every encoded limit exists and is binary. This is noncomputability of the input-dependent map, not of each individual binary number. No total computable event-time bound/convergence modulus or sound, complete, terminatingly checkable all-input safety-certificate system is proposed to exist; finite-horizon computable simulation is not excluded.

A separate quartic-polynomial alternative H=r^2/2+a r^4+epsilon K, a>3epsilon C_bar, remains globally strongly convex with pointwise Hessian condition-number bound (3a+3epsilon C_bar)/(a-3epsilon C_bar), at most 4 for a=15epsilon C_bar. Its Hessian is unbounded at infinity: this is not the analytic variant's global near-identity smoothness bound. It has cubic Hamiltonian vector field, a different fixed common energy and the same decoder. Coefficients are computable, not all asserted rational; the clock includes pi.

Scope/resources: dimension and tensor compiler may be enormous; no efficient universal coefficient table, memory advantage or practical speedup is supplied. Initial points are exact computable recipes, not rational-only or fixed-resolution preparations. The coordinate/time changes can be slow and eta->0 slows simulation. The invariant encoding is exceptional and lower-dimensional; no positive-volume basin, fault tolerance or persistent-noise bound is proved. The sufficient finite-horizon error estimate e^(eta t)||delta z(0)||+(nu/eta)(e^(eta t)-1) is not an infinite-horizon robustness theorem or precision lower bound. General mixed position-momentum Hamiltonians are allowed; the subclass |p|^2/2+V(q) for convex V is not covered. No new physical law, buildable device, quantum result or super-Turing technology follows. Published cotangent/universal dynamics are credited; the proposed conjunction and historical priority remain open.
